previous_mirror_run.failure_observation: Both initiator timeouts were paired with responder RXERR crc.

two_run_descriptive_total.note: Descriptive bench total only; not a packet-loss probability estimate.

interpretation.scheduler_latency_conclusion: The event-driven responder remains low-microsecond and stable with COM3 as responder; the prior CRC observations did not reproduce in the immediate same-direction repeat.
interpretation.reliability_boundary: One clean repeat is insufficient to claim a deployment reliability rate or to prove the prior CRC events were purely random.

boundaries: Bench success counts are descriptive, not a deployment packet-loss probability.
No range, NLOS or interference conclusion is made.
Cross-clock RTT residual is diagnostic and is not one-way propagation delay.
Scheduler wait/wake counters are not an electrical energy measurement.
